name: Make these fit
prompt: Rework one line of {character}'s dialogue in {folder}.
The new words are a rough idea, not a string to paste in. Make the whole line read as natural speech in {character}'s voice: fix grammar, a/an, plural, tense. Keep the rest of the line as it is.
Keep the indent, the name and colon, and any #tags exactly as they are. In Yarn, a # { or } meant as text is written \# \{ \}.
If the line is in more than one place and the file or note doesn't say which, or you can't find it, change nothing and say why.
When done, answer in three lines: Before: (the old line), After: (the new line), Why: (what you adjusted).

checks.about: a # meant as text but not written \#

review: {character}'s line was reworked: "{old}" was to become, roughly, "{new}". Does the new line read as natural speech for {character}, with correct grammar, carry the new idea, and keep the rest of the line?

items.note: Grub's fussing over her, keep it warm
